The workflow, at a glance

01Lead research02Enrich · Route · Draft03Human review

A simplified view of the workflow.

The problem

As a solo founder, researching accounts and writing relevant first messages competed with the time needed to build and deliver. I wanted more throughput while preserving account-specific context.

What I built

I built a seven-stage Python pipeline covering lead scraping, enrichment, routing, personalized drafting, and upload to Instantly. Three LLM agents handle enrichment, routing, and drafting, calling Claude through OpenRouter. Apify and Google Sheets connect the research and operating workflow.

The cold-email infrastructure is part of this system: the value comes from connecting those stages into an end-to-end process.

The checks around the model

Do-not-contact checks run at three stages. Email verification happens before sending, a cross-channel reply-stop prevents continued follow-up, and a human approval gate sits before messages ship. These controls live in the workflow and code.

The result

Personalized outreach increased from roughly 10 to more than 60 messages per day. That is a throughput result from my own operation; it is not a claim about response rates or revenue.
